title: Gaisano Country Mall Fun Run 2026 Review: Cebu's 33rd-Anniversary Charity Race
seo_title: Gaisano Country Mall Fun Run 2026 Review | Cebu Philippines
meta_description: The 33rd Anniversary Gaisano Country Mall Fun Run 2026: October 18 in Cebu City. 21K/12K/6K benefiting SOS Children's Village with registration open from PHP 1,200.
dek: Set for 18 October 2026 at Banilad Road in Cebu City, this Gaisano Country Mall charity run celebrates 33 years with three distances benefitting SOS Children's Village. Registration open from PHP 1,200.
verdict: The 33rd Anniversary Gaisano Country Mall Fun Run is a Cebu community charity race with genuine heritage — 33 years of a homegrown Cebu retail brand supporting SOS Children's Village. Three distances (21K, 12K, 6K) with the unusual 12K mid-distance and registration open from PHP 1,200-1,500. The Banilad Road venue in Cebu City is a central, accessible location. October in Cebu is the transition into the northeast monsoon, with improving conditions. A community-rooted Cebu race with charity purpose and three decades of history.

sections.heading: 33 Years: A Cebu Retail Institution
paragraphs: Gaisano Country Mall is a Cebu retail institution, and the 33rd-anniversary fun run supports SOS Children's Village — a well-regarded child-welfare charity. [1] The 12K distance is an unusual mid-distance option between the standard 10K and 21K. Banilad Road is one of Cebu City's main commercial corridors.
